meta.title: Application name, copied from the PRD.
meta.updated_at: Date this index was last written (YYYY-MM-DD).

ver: Version counter. Starts at 1; incremented on every write.

usecases.id: Stable kebab-case identifier, e.g. 'usecase-001--login'. Format: 'usecase-{NNN}--{slug}'. Never changed after creation.
usecases.name: Short human-readable name, e.g. 'User Login'.
usecases.screen_ids: List of screen IDs where this usecase appears (references screen-index). Many-to-many.
